title: "Multi-Season Breakdown"
format: html
---

Compare player and team trends across the **2021–2022**, **2022–2023**, and **2023–2024** seasons.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 2023-2024 Season

```
{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Example multi-season dataset visual using diamonds/built-in high-volume data
diamonds %>%
  filter(carat > 0.5) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = carat, y = price, color = cut)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "magma") +
  theme_dark(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "2023–2024 Performance Metrics",
    subtitle = "High-Density Performance Trends",
    x = "Volume / Minutes",
    y = "Efficiency Rating"
  )
```
